basic.name: Seeker Missile
basic.description: Releases a slow moving missile at the targeted unit. The missile will chase the target for 7 seconds. If it gets within 3 range of the target, it will rapidly travel forward and impact, dealing 0 damage to the target and nearby enemies.
Deploy an Auto-Turret at the targeted location. Auto-Turrets are stationary attack turrets that will attack any enemies that come into range.
